deviations_from_card: (1) The write set shrank. pick.ts is unchanged: since engines A, a pick with no lesson field already rejects as a shape EngineError, and the lesson job turns that into failed + noLesson. app/tv/page.tsx is unchanged too, because the keymap moved to tv/keys.ts in tv-surface A. keys.ts is the coupled file the orchestrator named. tv-keys-test.cjs is unchanged and green. (2) Engines are stubbed at the registry (useProvider) instead of at lib/engines/text.ts, following engines A. (3) Case 1 also asserts a 502 answer and job.key === topic. Case 4 also covers a superseded pick for the same hint: only the newest pick counts. (4) There is one extra test beyond the 8 cases: the TV keymap reads s.jobs, and topic.open keeps the focus on the open topic. That second part is a small store change (topic.open used to reset focus to 0). Without it, Select after a failed set would have retried topic 0 instead of the failed topic. (5) Every job failure answers 502, including routes that used to answer 500, and the error body is the desk sentence, not String(e). (6) The Playwright capture of the TV was not run. The TV changes use only existing caption and ticker classes, with no new band.
notes: EXPORTS. desk/src/lib/session/store.ts: type JobKind = 'read'|'hint'|'lesson'|'explain'|'mark'|'practice'|'analyse'|'memory'. JobPhase = 'running'|'done'|'failed'. interface Job {id, phase, startedAt, endedAt?, key?, error?}. Jobs = Partial<Record<JobKind, Job>>. Session.jobs: Jobs holds one record per kind: the latest run. INTERRUPTED is the sentence load() writes when it demotes a saved running job to failed. Events: {type:'job.start', kind, id, key?}, {type:'job.done', kind, id}, {type:'job.failed', kind, id, error}. job.done and job.failed are dropped unless id === s.jobs[kind].id. lesson.set has an optional key and is dropped when key !== s.hint?.key. A lesson.set without a key (the TV's own unit/calendar picks) always lands. A job.failed for the lesson kind, keyed to the hint on screen, sets noLesson=true. hint.set counts +1 for every hint and, at stage 1 only, clears lesson and noLesson. hint.stage(2) no longer counts; it only adds the problem to log.hard. desk/src/lib/desk/job.ts: runJob<T>(kind, work: (run: {id, current(): boolean}) => Promise<T>, opts?: {key?, supersedes?, start?: string, done?: (v: T) => string, onFail?: (e) => void}) => Promise<{ok:true, value:T} | {ok:false, status:409|502, error}>. A running kind is refused with 409 and BUSY, with no engine call, unless supersedes is set (only the lesson pick sets it). A failure runs onFail, dispatches job.failed with jobError(kind, e), and writes status as `${error} (${detail})`. jobError picks its 'why' sentence from EngineError.kind (timeout, unreachable, exit, shape); any other error becomes '<what> Try again.'. The work function dispatches its own domain events (practice.set etc.) BEFORE returning. job.done is only dispatched while run.current(). Also exported: refused(r) -> NextResponse.json({error}, {status}), BUSY, jobError. ROUTE KEYS: practice uses key=topic id; hint uses item.key, and the hint route checks for a running hint job before it dispatches 'item', so a refused hint does not move the item; lesson uses item.key with supersedes; read uses the page id, and its onFail dispatches page.read with no items; explain uses String(item.n); analyse uses 'english' or 'essay'; memory has no key. FOR desk-pipelines B: wrap the settle work in runJob('explain', async () => {...; dispatch practice.settle ...; return {...}}, {key: String(item.n), start, done}) and return refused(r) when !r.ok. The explain route today returns {reply, slip} from r.value. FOR engines B (retry-in-place): Job has no request payload. To retry in place, add optional fields to Job (e.g. attempt, retryable) in store.ts and a retry option to runJob. The id check already drops a superseded run's events. TV: tv/keys.ts exports running(s, kind) and practiceFailed(s, topicId). Out.hint and Topics Select are skipped while the matching job is running, on top of the local busy and hintInFlight flags. screens.tsx: the Topics caption shows 'Not written' + job.error for the focused failed topic. The Hint screen button says 'No lesson this time' when its keyed pick failed. The Page .cap overlay shows a failed read, or a hint that is running or failed. KNOWN WART, outside this write set: phone/page.tsx prefixes errors ('The desk could not read it: ${j.error}'), and the desk sentence now reads 'The desk could not read it: The desk could not read that page. ...'. A phone card should show j.error alone.
